title: Vehicle stats

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

name.description: Display name, as in items.json (the game's UI table). Absent when the game has none.

asset.description: Path of the vehicle stats asset inside the game files.

maxSpeed.description: Top speed as shown in the vehicle shop (km/h).

fuelEconomy.description: Fuel use as shown in the shop, in liters per kilometer (the shop rounds `1 / kmPerLiter` to one decimal).

weapons.description: Names of the weapons listed in the shop.

weaponIcons.description: Icon of each weapon in `weapons` that the game has one for, by weapon name: a path inside `assets/icons/`. The game's UI tables name the vehicle's weapon extensions with the same names.

counterMeasures.description: Names of the countermeasures listed in the shop.

damageEntity.description: The `entity` of this vehicle's damage rules in damage.json, such as `Vehicle.Land.Wheeled.Humvee.Default`. Variants of one platform can share it.

health.description: Vehicle health. Absent when the vehicle has no gameplay systems asset.

initial.description: Hit points of a new vehicle.

criticalThreshold.description: Health at or below which the vehicle is in a critical state, as stored.

bleedOutTime.description: Seconds a vehicle in the critical state lasts before it is destroyed, as stored.

kmPerLiter.description: Distance in kilometers one liter of fuel lasts, as stored (`1 / kmPerLiter` is liters per kilometer).

destroyedExplosion.description: The explosion when the vehicle is destroyed.

radius.description: Distance in meters at which the wreck's explosion damage reaches its minimum.

effectiveRadius.description: Distance in meters within which the wreck's explosion does full damage.

falloff.description: How fast the explosion's damage falls with distance, as stored.

mass.description: Mass of the vehicle body as the game's physics stores it (kg). Wheeled vehicles and helicopters only: tracked vehicles store no body mass in their files (no mass override in the blueprint's body; the track and sprocket masses are in `tracks`), so none is published.

engine.description: Engine of a wheeled or tracked vehicle. Helicopters have no engine curve in the data read.

torque.description: Torque at that speed, as stored.

torqueCurve.description: Engine torque by engine speed, as the keys of the game's curve (rpm and torque as stored, sorted by rpm). The game interpolates between keys.

torqueScale.description: Multiplier on the curve's torque. Absent when the game leaves it at its default.

frictionTorque.description: Engine braking torque, as stored. Absent when the game leaves it at its default.

idleRpm.description: Idle speed. Absent when the game leaves it at its default.

limitRpm.description: Rev limiter speed. Absent when the game leaves it at its default.

boostScale.description: Torque multiplier while boosting, as stored.

extraPowerRatio.description: Extra power multiplier of a tracked vehicle's engine, as stored.

transmission.description: Gearbox of a wheeled or tracked vehicle.

gearRatios.description: Gear ratios in the order the game stores them. A wheeled vehicle's last entry is reverse; tracked vehicles list some entries the game does not document, so read them with care.

finalGearRatio.description: Final drive ratio (a tracked vehicle's differential ratio).

changeTime.description: Time a gear change takes, as stored.

gearUpRatio.description: Engine load at which an automatic gearbox shifts up, as stored.

gearDownRatio.description: Engine load at which an automatic gearbox shifts down, as stored.

tracks.description: Masses of a tracked vehicle's track parts, when the game sets them.

trackMass.description: Mass of the track, as stored. Absent when the game leaves it at its default.

sprocketMass.description: Mass of a drive sprocket, as stored. Absent when the game leaves it at its default.

vehicles.description: One entry per vehicle variant, sorted by id.

description: Vehicle statistics as the game shows them in the vehicle shop. Ids are vehicle items in items.json.
